author: RQXblockman5
body:
Why was I banned for derp. I was playing Avicus-Nebula when the moderator SnowSX3 banned me for no reason. Please give me evidence. If there is no evidence appeal me. Please show me your evidence SnowSX3.

Thanks,

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Hello,

Thanks for the appeal RQX! Due to the fact that the moderator who banned you had no evidence I have decided to appeal you! Sorry for the inconvenience. 

Thanks,
Iron,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
